subject: Ballon d'Or
hook: BALLON D'OR IS NOT WHAT YOU THINK
angle: The Ballon d'Or was originally restricted to only European players, and it was not until 1995 that the award was expanded to include players of any origin active at European clubs.
angle_support: Originally, it was awarded only to players from Europe and was also known as the European Footballer of the Year award.
In 1995, the Ballon d'Or was expanded to include all players of any origin active at European clubs.
title: Why the Ballon d'Or was originally exclusive
description: Discover the restrictive origins of football's most famous individual award. Before 1995, the Ballon d'Or was closed to all players born outside of Europe.
narration: BALLON D'OR IS NOT WHAT YOU THINK You picture a global prize honoring the world's best football talent. It was closer to a strictly continental trophy, limited exclusively to players born within European borders. For nearly forty years, the award ignored every player outside Europe regardless of their talent. Only in 1995 did the rules shift to include anyone playing for a European club, finally opening the door to non-European icons. Before then, the world's greatest players were simply not even eligible.
